runtime.execution: Rust multithreaded Tokio CLI/core; optional Deno/pctx code-mode runs on blocking thread; MCP local stdio/builtin and remote services; desktop UI outside core trace.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes provider/MCP tools; owns sessions/SQLite conversation and optional schedule/child lifecycle; pctx kernel internals external dependency.

summary: Extensible Rust agent with a concrete optional composable state machine, dynamic MCP tools, independent multi-provider delegation, recipes/scheduling and bounded cross-session orchestration.

inspection.scope: CLI entry; old stream loop and optional operation pipeline; provider/action/result effect flow; native file/shell and code-mode wrapper, delegate/orchestrator, recipes/scheduler, compaction retention, recall/telemetry and selected source oracles.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Optional code-mode dependency runtime internals, desktop UI and all extensions/providers not read. State-machine path is opt-in; default older loop inspected in core request/dispatch/cancellation segments. Full original event logging, executable refit and governed self-improvement not traced.

actions.name: write / edit / shell / tree / read_image
actions.input: Structured file replacement/write, shell command/timeout, tree path or image path
actions.output: File outcomes, structured stdout/stderr/exit/truncation metadata or image
actions.lifecycle: Awaited actions; shell emits live notifications, cancel kills immediate child and drains streams for 500ms
actions.authority: Goose mode/inspectors, enabled developer extension, session working directory

actions.name: list_functions / get_function_details / execute_typescript / execute_bash
actions.input: Function filters or TypeScript/code+disclosure/tool graph; bash command
actions.output: Schemas or code outcome Markdown; nested extension tool results
actions.lifecycle: pctx code-mode calls on blocking thread; extension timeout/cancel propagated to callback token
actions.authority: Enabled code-mode extension; underlying pctx implementation not in inspected snapshot

actions.name: load / delegate
actions.input: Sources/named recipe/agent or instructions; provider/model/context/extensions, async; task ID and peek/cancel
actions.output: Loaded instructions or independent child result/background task status
actions.lifecycle: Separate session/context; async handle supports wait/peek/cancel; live notifications; no nested delegation
actions.authority: Parent model may choose provider/model; children forced Auto because approval forwarding unavailable

actions.name: orchestrator__list_sessions / view_session / start_agent / send_message / interrupt_agent
actions.input: Session filters/id, working directory/name, message text
actions.output: Sessions, summaries/endpoints, new session ID, reply text, cancellation acknowledgement
actions.lifecycle: Messaging actually drives target reply and awaits it; busy target rejected rather than queued
actions.authority: Target authorization checked; start uses parent provider/model

actions.name: scheduler__manage_schedule
actions.output: Schedule record or produced session inspection
actions.lifecycle: Optional configured scheduler; recurring recipe lifecycle
actions.authority: Model-enabled platform tool; scheduler owns schedule execution

actions.name: extensionmanager__search_available_extensions / manage_extensions / list_resources / read_resource
actions.input: Available extension name enable/disable, resource URI
actions.lifecycle: Current manager can change connected extensions; schema-hash invalidates code-mode cache
actions.authority: Parent user sessions allowed; subagents denied; cannot disable manager itself

actions.name: chatrecall__chatrecall
actions.output: Messages grouped by session or bounded first/last three
actions.lifecycle: Saved-history search, not raw original-event replay
actions.authority: Model with extension; stored conversation visibility boundaries

actions.name: Agent.reply / StateMachine.step / apply / run / Operation / Inference
actions.output: Event stream or one applicable step/effects; persisted conversation continuation
actions.lifecycle: Explicit optional machine; concrete host pipeline remains compiled/internal
actions.authority: Embedding author can compose/redefine pipelines; not model hot replacement

actions.name: /compact / /clear / recipe commands and YAML/JSON recipes
actions.output: Summary/replaced history or configured independent run
actions.lifecycle: Managed summary includes completed tool-pair constraint; declarative model/extension/output config
actions.authority: Operator and model delegation source loading; recipe does not redefine compiled turn protocol

actions.name: analyze / todo__todo_write / summarize__summarize; optional apps catalog
actions.input: Code structure path/mode; full TODO replacement; paths/question/extensions for summary; feature-dependent apps schemas
actions.output: Structure, persisted TODO or model summary; app tool internals not individually traced
actions.lifecycle: Registered native/feature-gated extension actions; generated/plugin catalogs remain individually discoverable
actions.authority: Enabled/feature flags and mode; representative catalog inspection rather than full media/app implementation trace

filesystem.detail: Native write/edit/tree/image and shell provide local files; exact unique text edits via structured params.

processes.detail: Streamed awaited shell command with timeout/cancel and output artifacts; immediate-child kill and no writable PTY/background shell handle in traced developer surface.

code_actions.detail: Feature-dependent pctx TypeScript/bash code-mode invokes current extension callbacks; wrapper execution/cancellation traced.

persistent_kernel.detail: pctx CodeMode wrapper/schema cache inspected; dependency runtime implementation/namespace survival not present in this bounded trace. Cached callbacks do not establish a persistent notebook kernel.

standing_database.detail: SQLite session storage and chat-history querying are standing internal data primitives, not arbitrary shared external research database action.

workflow_programming.detail: Public Operation/Inference/StateMachine pipeline composition plus parameterized recipes, retries/subrecipes and optional scheduling; concrete Goose operations internal.

multi_model.detail: Delegate supports provider/model overrides and own context; orchestrator start separately inherits parent selection.

live_collaboration.detail: Orchestrator exposes session inspection, send and interrupt; sending awaits target turn and rejects busy recipients. Independent delegates explicitly lack peer coordination.

concurrent_work.detail: Tool result/notification streams selected together; async delegation has separate handles and can overlap; no shared-write arbitration established.

steering_interrupt.detail: Between-turn FIFO steering, provider/tool cancellation and scripted cancellation-resume tests; peer send is not queued busy steering.

turn_redefinition.detail: Embedding authors can supply ordered Operation/Inference implementations; shipped concrete host steps are internal and opt-in machine disabled by default. Model tool/recipe changes do not replace turn kernel.

compaction.detail: Automatic/manual summary, pair-result token accounting, incomplete-pair guard and persisted visibility changes retain original message content.

context_repair.detail: Saved message visibility graph and chatrecall bounded history reads allow recovery composition; no model-operated precise context lineage repair traced.

original_audit.detail: Stored conversations retain pre-compaction content, but optional telemetry and reconstructed finish reasons explicitly limit original wire evidence; all program/provider stream events not established.

audit_query.detail: Model chatrecall searches saved messages and bounded session endpoints; it is not complete original-audit query.

hot_change.detail: Parent model can enable/disable configured extensions and schema-hash refresh code-mode callbacks; subagent restrictions and compiled machine remain. No executable refit continuity traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Not established in the inspected entry, model loop, action dispatch and state paths; no universal absence claim.

remote_services.detail: Remote MCP streamable HTTP client implementation and provider/extension dispatch consume outside services; ownership varies with stdio/builtin clients.

self_improvement.detail: Writable source/recipes and model extension reconfiguration support operator-composed improvement; measured governed executable autoresearch not established.

complaints.detail: Not established in the inspected entry, model loop, action dispatch and state paths; no universal absence claim.

authority.detail: Auto default with Ask/SmartApprove/Chat alternatives; inspector executable decisions persisted. Delegates forced Auto due absent action-required forwarding.

evaluation.detail: Specific scripted provider and extension routing oracles read; no provider-performance result or runtime conformance inferred.

time_order.detail: Live event generated IDs and durable message/effect boundaries; steering FIFO; background Instant state. No total distributed audit order guarantee.

Generic machine exported; concrete Goose operations internal and feature flag false by default.

Effects persisted before confirmation events; compaction history-replacement events after storage.

Recipe structured instructions, extensions, parameters, settings/model, output schema, retries and sub-recipes.

FIFO queue applied between model/tool turns with prompt hooks and persisted message effects.

Operator compact/clear and model summary compacted conversation replacement effects.
Compaction storage transaction updates visibility of old message IDs and inserts new summaries; content retained.
Model chatrecall searches past chat/date filters or loads bounded session endpoints.
Message content capture is optional; reconstructed output finish reason is not original provider finish reason.
Model enable/disable dispatch; subagents cannot manage and manager cannot disable itself.
Model extension search/manage tools advertised.
Goose-mode inspectors persist executable decisions/permission changes and approval request effects.
Auto default, Approve, SmartApprove and Chat authority modes.
FIFO/compaction/cancel-resume scripted provider tests assert exact subsequent inputs and once-only steer.
Notification ordering test checks child events precede final result with preserved child ID.
Direct management test refuses subagent enable/disable while user can alter developer extension.
Actual remote streamable HTTP transport connection and OAuth fallback.
Native extension registration plus exact unprefixed-tool and feature flags.
todo_write catalog and dispatch; complete content replacement.

summarize file/directory/question action catalog.

tests.oracle: Scripted held provider responses verify both FIFO steers in next request, compaction system includes redirected guidance, cancel retains queue and resume delivers exactly once.
Repeated synthetic stream test asserts three child-tagged notifications arrive before delegate result; notification pipeline oracle, not child/provider execution test.
Calls management directly with persisted user/subagent session types and checks enabled manager state changes only for user.

strengths: Reusable first-applicable-step/effects protocol can be composed independently of UI.
Compaction preserves old stored message content through visibility metadata.
Model extension discovery and reconfiguration have actual dispatch.
Live delegate notification and queued-steering tests assert meaningful ordering.
limits: Optional code-mode dependency runtime internals, desktop UI and all extensions/providers not read. State-machine path is opt-in; default older loop inspected in core request/dispatch/cancellation segments. Full original event logging, executable refit and governed self-improvement not traced.
arconaut_questions: Can Arconaut expose a programmable turn definition to the model without shipping an immutable host pipeline?
Should busy peer messages queue with durable receipts instead of reject?
How should externally owned processes and shared kernels expose cancellable handles beyond bounded shell calls?
What original provider/program event loss would a trace replay oracle detect beyond saved conversation?
How should async delegation authority remain explicit when approval forwarding is unsupported?
